questions.q: In a group of 40 people, 19 like Hindi, 20 like English and 13 like both. How many like neither?
Pointing to a boy, Sunita said, 'He is the son of my husband's only sister.' How is the boy related to Sunita?
questions.why: The son of her husband's sister is her nephew.

questions.why: An odometer measures distance travelled; a barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.q: Statement: "The company has launched a new marketing campaign." Conclusions: 1. The company wants to increase its sales. 2. The company is facing financial issues.
questions.why: Campaigns aim at sales; nothing points to financial trouble. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: If ROAD is written as URDG in a certain code, how is FORT written?
questions.why: Each letter moves three places forward: F-I, O-R, R-U, T-W.

questions.q: If KNIGHT is written as MPKIJV in a certain code, how is MEDICAL written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward: MEDICAL → OGFKECN. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A woman says, 'I weigh 50 kg plus one third of my weight.' What is her weight?
questions.why: w = 50 + w/3, so w = 75. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 8, 27, 64, 125, ?
questions.why: These are the cubes of 2, 3, 4 and 5. The next is 6 cubed, 216.
